description: Standalone fixture app used to validate template and pipeline changes cheaply.

features.name: SQLite Database Schema
features.description: SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, projects, and tasks. Uses SQLite with file-based storage. Models: User (email, hashed_password, name), Project (name, description, owner_id), Task (title, description, project_id, assignee_id, status).

work_history.note: Verified SQLAlchemy models (User, Project, Task) in models.py with all tables, FKs, and cascade relationships; database.py engine + get_db session. test_models.py passes.

features.completion_notes: SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, projects, tasks with FK relationships and cascade delete. SQLite file-based storage via database.py. All 3 model tests pass.

features.name: Frontend Project Setup
features.description: Next.js 14 app with Tailwind CSS. App Router structure with pages for login, register, dashboard, projects, and tasks. API client using axios with empty baseURL and Next.js rewrites to proxy /api/* to backend port 8000. Use next.config.mjs (not .ts).

work_history.note: Verified Next.js 14 App Router with Tailwind, all pages (login/register/dashboard/projects/tasks), axios client with empty baseURL + relative /api URLs, next.config.mjs rewrites proxy. 21 jest tests pass, npm run build green.

features.completion_notes: Next.js 14 App Router + Tailwind fully scaffolded. axios client empty baseURL, next.config.mjs rewrites /api/* to backend. 21 jest tests pass, npm run build succeeds (11 routes).

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: POST /api/auth/register accepts {email, password, name}, creates user with bcrypt-hashed password, returns JWT. POST /api/auth/login validates credentials, returns {token}. GET /api/users/me returns current user profile. JWT middleware extracts user from Authorization: Bearer header.

work_history.note: Verified POST /api/auth/register (bcrypt hash + JWT), POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/users/me, JWT Bearer middleware in auth.py + routers/auth.py. 8 auth tests pass.

features.completion_notes: Auth fully implemented: register with bcrypt+JWT, login, /api/users/me, JWT Bearer middleware. 8 auth tests pass.

features.name: Dashboard

features.name: Navigation and Layout
features.description: Sidebar navigation with route highlighting and logout button. AuthGuard component protects authenticated routes. Layout component wraps all authenticated pages.

features.name: Project Management
features.description: Full CRUD for projects. POST /api/projects creates project with owner_id from auth. GET /api/projects lists user's projects. GET /api/projects/{id} returns single project. DELETE /api/projects/{id} removes project. Frontend pages: /projects (list), /projects/new (create form).

work_history.note: Verified existing implementation in routers/projects.py satisfies full CRUD spec: POST/GET list/GET one/PUT/DELETE at /api/projects, owner_id from auth, isolation enforced. Manually curl-verified all endpoints (201/200/200/200/204/404/401). 8 project tests pass in test_projects.py.

features.completion_notes: Full CRUD for projects already implemented in routers/projects.py per architecture.json spec (create/list/read/update/delete at /api/projects, owner_id scoping). Verified via pytest (8 tests in test_projects.py) and live curl smoke test against running server (create 201, list/get/update 200, delete 204, 404 after delete, 401 unauthenticated).

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Full CRUD for tasks with project assignment. POST /api/tasks creates task with project_id. GET /api/tasks lists user's tasks. DELETE /api/tasks/{id} removes task. Frontend pages: /tasks (list), /tasks/new (create form with project selector).
